items.title: Gain XP
items.detail: Completes passively or grind West Tek for fastest XP

items.title: Collect Legendary Scrip
items.detail: Trade legendary weapons or armor at a Legendary Exchange Machine

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Obtain from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Rust Raider
items.detail: Fast travel to The Rust Kingdom in Burning Springs

items.title: Kill an Enemy during a Daily Operation
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops and kill enemies; completion not required

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to a vendor; Whitespring Resort has multiple

items.title: Use Photomode in a Teammate's C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Join a team, fast travel to teammate's C.A.M.P., use Photomode overlay

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap from Defense menu; Punji Board costs 4 steel and 8 wood

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs or plant in C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Giant Teapot or Tanagra Town cave for reliable spawns

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest during final stage of Slasher event at Head Hunt

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 cultists

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Degrade a weapon by hitting enemies, then repair at workbench

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint under encumbrance limit on open ground; fast travel does not count

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Finish any six of that day's daily challenges on three separate days

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events feature mutated variants with special party package rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience gain is doubled across all activities.

events.description: Treasure Hunter event with rare rewards concurrent with double mutations.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
